newsitem.title: THAILAND: Deposit run on Thai finance firms slows - cent bank.
newsitem.headline: Deposit run on Thai finance firms slows - cent bank.

text.p: Runs on deposits at Thai finance companies and commercial banks have slowed sharply since the financial sector was rocked by a crisis of confidence earlier this month, the central bank said on Thursday.
The bank said in a statement total net withdrawals from all 103 finance companies totalled 19.57 billion baht ($752.7 million) between March 5 to 17.
The highest net withdrawal of deposits from all 103 Thai finance firms in one day during that period was on March 5 when 12.12 billion baht was withdrawn.
The largest net deposit at the end of the day between March 5-17 was on March 14, when 3.09 billion baht was added to the financial institutions' coffers.
The latest figure available showed total withdrawals of 5.97 billion baht on March 17, the central bank said.
On March 3, Thai economic authorities shook up the financial markets by ordering 10 finance firms, hard-hit by a liquidity crunch, to raise capital.
The order sparked a public run on deposits of several finance companies, especially the 10 firms ordered to raise capital. ($1=26 baht)
